stories.title: Rigettato il ricorso di Ranucci, la redazione: "Mai sfiduciato o chiesto la sua rimozione"

en.title: Ranucci's Appeal Rejected, Editorial Staff: "Never Removed Trust or Asked for His Removal"
en.summary: A journalist's appeal against a Rai decision was rejected, confirming the legitimacy of a Rai3 program reorganization. The editorial staff stated it responds to controversies through investigations.

stories.title: Verstappen è tornato: pole a Singapore, ma Leclerc e Hamilton sono vicinissimi

en.title: Verstappen is Back: Pole at Singapore, but Leclerc and Hamilton are Very Close
en.summary: Verstappen secured pole position in Singapore after winning the Sprint, with Leclerc and Hamilton closely behind in qualifying. Antonelli posted fourth time on a difficult Mercedes.

stories.title: Usa, dopo il caso Pike e Hasan torna la polemica sulla pena di morte. Il Papa: "È inammissibile"

en.title: USA, After Pike and Hasan Cases, Death Penalty Controversy Returns. Pope: "It is Inadmissible"
en.summary: Two cases in the United States have reignited international debate over capital punishment. The Pope calls it inadmissible, the UN considers it torture, and American opposition to the death penalty is growing.

stories.title: F1, Verstappen pigliatutto a Singapore: vince la Sprint e conquista la "pole"

en.title: F1, Verstappen Sweeps Singapore: Wins Sprint and Secures "Pole"
en.summary: Verstappen won the Sprint and secured pole position in Singapore, with Ferrari drivers Hamilton and Leclerc completing the podium for the short race. The main race takes place tomorrow with Leclerc starting second on the grid.

stories.title: Leone XIV dopo l’annuncio del Pentagono sull’esecuzione in streaming: “Pena di morte inammissibile”

en.title: Pope Francis after Pentagon announcement on streaming execution: "Death penalty inadmissible"
en.summary: Pope Francis posted a message on X during the day against capital punishment, following recent condemnation by U.S. bishops regarding an announced streaming execution.

stories.title: Media, udita forte esplosione all'aeroporto di Riad, evacuazione in corso

en.title: Media report loud explosion heard at Riyadh airport, evacuation underway
en.summary: A loud explosion was reported at Riyadh airport prompting an evacuation, after the airport had earlier advised passengers to check their flight status.

stories.title: Gp Singapore: Verstappen beffa le Ferrari: “Era la pole che volevo”

en.title: Singapore GP: Verstappen outwits Ferrari: "It was the pole position I wanted"
en.summary: Verstappen secured pole position after winning the sprint race, with Leclerc second by 0.054 seconds and Hamilton third. Antonelli finished fourth.

stories.title: Il Papa, 'la pena di morte è inammissibile'

en.title: Pope: 'Death penalty is inadmissible'
en.summary: Pope Francis stated that the common good can be protected without resorting to capital punishment.

stories.title: Riad, aeroporto colpito da un missile Houthi: evacuazione e stop ai voli

en.title: Riyadh, airport hit by Houthi missile: evacuation and flight suspension
en.summary: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia was struck by a missile fired by Houthis, prompting evacuation and suspension of flights.

stories.title: Guerra in Iran. Esplosioni a Riad, evacuato l’aeroporto. Media: “Colpito da un missile Houthi”

en.title: War in Iran. Explosions in Riyadh, airport evacuated. Media: "Hit by Houthi missile"
en.summary: Explosions at Riyadh's airport resulted in dozens of injuries including at least five serious cases. Palestinian elections have been postponed to September 11, 2027.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia, news. Kallas: “Stop a sanzioni su gasolio russo finanzia guerra di Mosca”

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war, news. Kallas: "Stop sanctions on Russian diesel finances Moscow's war"
en.summary: Russian strikes on Zaporizhzhia killed 17 people including three children, with one woman rescued from rubble. Putin's spokesman indicated openness to certain U.S. de-escalation proposals.

stories.title: La devastazione della doppia tromba marina a Marsala: auto ribaltate e feriti

en.title: Destruction caused by double waterspout in Marsala: overturned cars and injuries
en.summary: A double waterspout struck the port area of Marsala in Sicily, causing damage to buildings, vehicles and crops, with reported injuries.

stories.title: Tatuaggi e piercing, imprese più che raddoppiate in 10 anni

en.title: Tattoos and piercings, businesses more than doubled in 10 years
en.summary: Tattoo and piercing businesses in Italy increased by 160 percent between 2017 and 2026, with Rome leading in absolute numbers and Bari showing the fastest growth rate.

stories.title: L’export resiste alla crisi energetica. Diversificare chiave per la crescita

en.title: Exports resist energy crisis. Diversification key for growth
en.summary: A Promos Italia white paper examines Italian export trends between 2021 and 2026, analyzing how exports have performed through economic and geopolitical challenges.

stories.title: Parte a Torino il progetto per il “super caccia”. In arrivo duemila posti

en.title: Turin launches 'super fighter' project. Two thousand jobs coming
en.summary: Edgewing, a joint venture between Leonardo, BAE Systems, and Jaiec, is opening its first development and design facility in Turin, with aircraft production planned for Caselle.

stories.title: Tecnologia e spinta estera per la Liuc del futuro

en.title: Technology and international push for Liuc's future
en.summary: Liuc university is integrating artificial intelligence into its programs while expanding international engagement and strengthening connections with businesses through external partnerships.

stories.title: Una estate in chiaroscuro per le agenzie di viaggio

en.title: A mixed summer for travel agencies
en.summary: Travel agencies are assessing results from a challenging season marked by geopolitical tensions, high fuel costs, and last-minute booking patterns.
